en.name: Extends salary reductions for managers through fiscal 2026
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance on Temporary Special Measures for the Salaries of Fussa City General-Service Employees
en.summary: The period for the measure reducing salaries for management-level employees will be extended through fiscal 2026. The salary reduction rates will also be revised.
changes: Extends the period for salary reductions through fiscal 2026
en.why: The city says this is to extend the period for salary reductions for management-level employees and revise the reduction rates.
